0022600174.text: The Wizards, who are 4-3 and first in the Southeast and sixth in the East, host the Atlanta Hawks, who are 4-4 and second in the Southeast, half a game back, and seventh in the East. Washington enters on a two-game winning streak and is 2-1 at home, while Atlanta is on a one-game winning streak and is 1-2 on the road. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Wizards lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 126-96 loss in Atlanta on February 26, 2026.
